common_reference_mae.denominator_rule: 4 x references matched at IoU 0.5 by every arm

scoring.aggregation: sums, never averages of rates; abstentions stay in denominators
scoring.common_reference_mae: references matched by all three arms at IoU 0.5; denominator 4 x common; null with reason if empty
scoring.matched_endpoint_mae: all four endpoints of matched pairs; denominator 4 x matched pairs; null if none
scoring.matching: phrase_proposal_s1.score_rows: maximum cardinality then maximum mean two-span IoU
scoring.negative_false_candidates: candidate count per negative cohort over 2 cases
